title: DBDGEN: SEGM statements coded in hierarchic order, the dependent naming its parent
shapes: HKEP HKEPDBD: SEGM NAME=KEEP / SEGM NAME=WALL,PARENT=KEEP / SEGM NAME=GATE,PARENT=WALL
asserts: HKEPDBD keys one ims_gen DBD fact and three SEGM facts (KEEP root, WALL parent KEEP, GATE parent WALL), in source order.

citations.section: DEDB DBD generation input record structure
citations.quote: SEGM statements must also be placed in the same hierarchic order as the segments in the database being defined.
